title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Security Mode Plus adds admin-set restrictions on top of Enhanced Security Mode
summary: Hold: the briefing says an unconfigured Plus control leaves today's behaviour unchanged, although Microsoft has not published its default. The roadmap details and existing Group Policy and registry references are supported, but the claimed tenant-wide scope is not established.
